newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia to get cross-borer gas pipe network.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia to get cross-borer gas pipe network.

text.p: Australia progressively will get a national network of interconnected gas transmission pipelines across state and territory borders, Resources and Energy Minister Warwick Parer said on Monday.

"It is very likely that gas transmission pipelines will be progressively interconnected across state borders in a competitive and interdependent multi-state gas market," Parer told an Australian Gas Association convention.
Parer also said competition reforms for the natural gas industry would provide new opportunities and growth prospects for the industry.

A draft code for transmission and distribution pipelines to allow gas consumers and producers to buy and sell on commercial terms would be discussed at a meeting of the Council of Australian Governments (COAG) in November, Parer said.

Prime Minister John Howard had also requested that the COAG meeting also consider the issue of a regulator for gas transmission pipelines throughout Australia, Parer said."We were asked to settle on a mode of regulation that would maximise competition and facilitate investment in the industry," he said.
Arguments for a national regulator were strong and included consistency of outcomes, lower transaction costs and reduced government costs from duplicating regulatory arrangements, Parer said.

He said the gas industry was now a major contributor to national economic growth, generating more than A$6 billion in annual sales revenue, a value-adding contribution of A$3 billion and export earnings of over A$1 billion.
